resources.string: WordBoard uses this Accessibility Service solely to detect your custom text shortcut triggers (like /addr or omw) across apps and seamlessly expand them or display the 1-tap expansion pop-up above your keyboard. WordBoard respects your privacy: no keystrokes or personal data are ever recorded, stored, or transmitted over the internet.
Allows WordBoard to display a quick 1-tap expansion pill right above your existing keyboard when you type a shortcut.
Required to detect shortcuts in WhatsApp, Gmail, Chrome, and any other app.
